messages:
emma_api: Noticing weirdness on the console: p50 sometimes > p95 for some endpoint slices when we enable per-route merge. Happens after a rollout of the new tdigest merge mode. Anyone seen monotonicity breaks?
frank_infra: yup saw that at ~02:30 UTC. My quick hypothesis: different sample weights from ingress vs. backend get merged incorrectly, leading to compressed tdigest centroids.
gina_sre: can you point to example? Which endpoint + slice?
emma_api: com.api.chat; slice=mobile-us. Query window: 02:25-02:35. CLI export: 
```
curl -sS 'https://metrics.api/redwood/v1/samples?endpoint=com.api.chat&slice=mobile-us&start=2025-04-12T02:25:00Z&end=2025-04-12T02:35:00Z' 
```
I grabbed raw samples and saw weights 1 and 0.2 mixed in.
frank_infra: weights 0.2? That's prob from the sampling proxy that downweights debug traffic. When tdigest merge assumes equal weight, centroids shift. We need to ensure merge respects sample weights.
gina_sre: Also check whether retry-tagged samples are duplicated with full weight on both ingress and retry path. That can inflate tails.
harry_prod: From product side, users only care that p50/p95/p99 are stable and explainable. If a toggle causes non-monotonic charts during canary, that's going to confuse customers. UX suggestion: add a "merge mode" badge on chart (legacy | tdigest-v2) with tooltip explaining tradeoffs.
emma_api: Agree. Technical proposal: 1) Add sample_weight to tdigest centroids and make merge weighted. 2) Expose a debug endpoint that returns monotonicity check (boolean) and offending percentiles list for a given query. 3) Default to legacy merge for 24h after rollout.
frank_infra: Implementation note: our current tdigest lib doesn't serialize weights. We'll need to change wire format and storage schema. Backfill: leave old rollups intact; new writes produce both legacy and weighted tdigests for 7 days.
gina_sre: For alerts: create a "percentile-nonmonotonic" annotation when p50>p95 or p95>p99 for the same slice. Add it to our incident runbook.
harry_prod: UX refinement: when non-monotonic detected show a small warning icon next to line with popup: "Percentile merge inconsistency possible; click to see raw sample histogram." Keep it non-alarming but visible.
emma_api: sample of the check script I used: 
```
# python pseudo
samps = load_samples(q)
for p in [50,95,99]:
  v = percentile(samps, p)
  if not monotonic(prev, v):
    print('non-monotonic', p, prev, v)
  prev = v
```
We can open-source a small linter for this to run during rollouts.
frank_infra: I'll prototype weighted tdigest serialization and a read-path that can return both legacy and weighted merged percentiles. ETA 2d.
gina_sre: I'll add the alert rule and a dashboard panel that shows "monotonicity ratio" (count of slices with violations).
harry_prod: I'll draft UI copy for the badge and modal. Happy to do a quick user test internally.
emma_api: Action items: frank implement prototype; gina add alert + dashboard; harry mock UX; emma write rollout checklist with verification steps (monotonicity regression < 0.1% slices).
observability-bot: NOTE: auto-detected percentile-inversion spike at 02:31 UTC (com.api.chat/mobile-us)  See /ops/monotonicity for details.
